archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Field Service & Construction

mobile_workers_view.description: Glove-friendly design. Mobile layout requires 2-3x padding. Controls must be massively enlarged for easy tapping by construction workers on-site.

admin_dashboard_view.description: Spreadsheet-like density (Grid Borders pattern). Admin manages large datasets, so utilize tight spacing and full screen width.

component_rules.buttons: Solid brand green for primary actions, large rounded-lg, strong hover states (bg-green-800), must include data-testid. min-h-[56px] for mobile.
component_rules.cards: Flat surfaces with 1px border (border-gray-200), no heavy shadows (shadow-sm max) for structural clarity.
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn UI but enlarged. min-h-[56px] on mobile. Text size 16px minimum to prevent iOS native zoom.
component_rules.tables: Admin only. Dense, border-collapse, sticky header. Text size 14px for maximum data visibility.
component_rules.navigation: Mobile: Bottom tab bar or sticky top header with large tap zones. Admin: Left sidebar (w-64) with dense link list.
component_rules.map_pins: Google Maps integration: large card with 'Otwórz w Google Maps' CTA and location pin icon.

micro_themes.admin: Grid Borders (The Technical Look) - exposed skeletons, clear data separation. Feels like a modern Excel to smooth their transition.
micro_themes.mobile: Functional Neumorphism - tactile but flat, sharp 1px borders to ground it. High contrast for outdoor readability in harsh sunlight.

animations.strategy: Minimalist functional. Button active state scale down slightly (scale-95). Fast transitions.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over brand green is pure white. High contrast required for sunlight readability. APCA contrast compliant.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, forms, tabs, inputs (e.g., data-testid='submit-hours-btn').

login_background.description: Abstract architectural blueprint lines, modern construction plans on a subtle green and light gray background
login_background.usage: Use as a full-cover background image on the login screens (admin and worker) with a white overlay/glassmorphism card on top.

brand_logo.description: FeGrro minimalist construction logo green and dark gray
brand_logo.usage: Use in header, sidebar, and login screens.

feature_specific_instructions.hours_entry: Workers select 'Today' or 'Yesterday' via large Segmented Controls (Shadcn Tabs) - DO NOT use calendar pickers for this. For hour input (1-14), use large custom '+' and '-' stepper buttons next to a readonly display, avoiding native numeric keyboards on site.
feature_specific_instructions.absence_toggle: Large, unmistakable switch/checkbox for 'Nieobecność'. When toggled on, hours input is completely disabled and faded out.
feature_specific_instructions.admin_approval: Highlight pending requests (hours > 10, or past days requests) with Amber warning color. Provide inline 1-click 'Zatwierdź' (Approve) or 'Odrzuć' (Reject) buttons in the admin table.
feature_specific_instructions.excel_sync: Show last sync timestamp prominently in Admin header. Provide a 'Wymuś synchronizację' (Force Sync) button with a spinning loader state.
feature_specific_instructions.map_integration: Workers see their assigned site with a massive 'Otwórz na mapie' button and Pin icon linking to Google Maps. Admin has an input field to store Google Maps URLs/Coords per construction site.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS purely. Install Shadcn UI components but customize spacing based on layout_and_spacing rules above.

DO NOT use Inter or Roboto fonts. Add `<link href="https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@800,500,700,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">` and Google Fonts for IBM Plex Sans in the main HTML.
Ensure all worker views are exclusively mobile-first with enormous tap targets. Admin view must be dense desktop layout.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements. This is a critical requirement.
All components must be in .js files, NOT .tsx.
DO NOT use raw dummy/placeholder image URLs. Use ONLY the image URLs provided in the images object of this JSON.
The primary action color must be Tailwind green-700 (#15803d) to align with FeGrro branding.
Install `lucide-react` for iconography (pins, user, calendar, check, x).
